name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted file toolkit to convert, compress, edit, OCR and transcribe images, video, audio, PDFs and documents through a web UI, REST API and pipelines.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated DEFAULT_PASSWORD from this app's environment settings; you are asked to choose a new password on first login. The variable only seeds the first admin, so changing it later has no effect.
The image is several GB and the server needs at least 2 GB of RAM. Optional AI bundles are downloaded from Settings into the data volume, and most of them need 4 GB of RAM or more.
